trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: Report the issue of having no signal.
steps.text: नमस्ते, सुबह से मेरे phone में signal नहीं आ रहा है।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and ask for MSISDN.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent empathizes and requests the mobile number.
steps.text: नमस्ते। मैं समझ सकती हूँ कि बिना signal के परेशानी होती है। क्या आप मुझे अपना mobile number बता सकती हैं?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent needs the user's mobile number to begin troubleshooting the signal issue.

steps.purpose: Provide MSISDN and volunteer context.
steps.text: हाँ, मेरा number MSN-2001 है। मैं पहली बार complain के लिए call कर रही हूँ।
steps.clean_text: हाँ, मेरा number MSN-2001 है। मैं पहली बार complain के लिए call कर रही हूँ।
steps.model_visible_text: हाँ, मेरा number MSN-2004 है। मैं पहली बार complain के लिए call कर रही हूँ।

steps.purpose: Confirm the misheard MSISDN.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent asks for confirmation of the number they heard.
steps.text: धन्यवाद। तो आपका number MSN-2004 है, सही?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent repeats the MSISDN to confirm its accuracy before proceeding.

steps.purpose: Correct the MSISDN and volunteer name.
steps.text: नहीं, आखिरी में one है। MSN-2001. और मेरा नाम Sunita Sharma है।
steps.clean_text: नहीं, आखिरी में one है। MSN-2001. और मेरा नाम Sunita Sharma है।
steps.model_visible_text: नहीं, आखिरी में one है। MSN-2001. और मेरा नाम Sunita Sharma है।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the corrected MSISDN and initiate verification.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent acknowledges the correct number and transitions to security verification.
steps.text: माफ़ कीजिएगा, MSN-2001. Security के लिए मैं आपकी details verify करती हूँ।
steps.planner_rationale: The user corrected the MSISDN and volunteered their name, allowing the agent to proceed with identity verification.

steps.purpose: Verify customer identity using the provided name.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent triggers the verification tool.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent calls the identity verification tool using the provided name and MSISDN.

steps.purpose: Return verification result.
Acknowledge verification success and ask for pincode.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent confirms verification and requests the pincode.
steps.text: आपकी details verify हो गई हैं। अब क्या आप अपना pincode बता सकती हैं ताकि मैं network check कर सकूँ?
steps.planner_rationale: With identity verified, the agent needs the pincode to check the network status.

steps.purpose: Provide pincode.
steps.text: मेरा pincode 411038 है।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge pincode and initiate network check.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent acknowledges the pincode and states they will check the network.
steps.text: ठीक है, मैं अभी आपके area का network status check करती हूँ।
steps.planner_rationale: The agent parses the pincode despite the ITN error and proceeds to check the network.

steps.purpose: Check network status for the given pincode.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent triggers the network status check.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent calls the network status tool using the MSISDN and pincode.

steps.purpose: Return network status result.
Inform the user about the network fault and ETA.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent quotes the exact figures from the tool result without making unsupported promises.
steps.text: Check करने के लिए धन्यवाद। आपके pincode 411038 में अभी एक network fault चल रहा है, जिससे 3 towers affected हैं। इसको ठीक होने में 6 hours लगेंगे।
steps.planner_rationale: The agent grounds the response entirely on the tool output, stating the exact number of affected towers and the ETA.

steps.purpose: Ask a clarifying question about raising a ticket.
steps.text: अच्छा, 6 hours लगेंगे? तो ticket raise करना पड़ेगा क्या इसके लिए?
steps.clean_text: अच्छा, 6 hours लगेंगे? तो ticket raise करना पड़ेगा क्या इसके लिए?
steps.model_visible_text: अच्छा, 6 hours लगेंगे? तो ticket race करना पड़ेगा क्या इसके लिए?

steps.purpose: Address the user's question about raising a ticket.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent naturally uses the English noun and Hindi verb construction 'ticket raise करने'.
steps.text: नहीं, क्योंकि यह एक known outage है, हमारी team पहले से ही इस पर काम कर रही है। नया ticket raise करने की ज़रूरत नहीं है।
steps.planner_rationale: Following business rule BR_NET_01, the agent explains that no duplicate ticket is needed for a known outage.

steps.purpose: Express doubt about the new handset.
steps.text: ठीक है। पर मेरा phone तो support करता है ना? मुझे doubt हो रहा है क्योंकि मैंने नया phone लिया है।
steps.clean_text: ठीक है। पर मेरा phone तो support करता है ना? मुझे doubt हो रहा है क्योंकि मैंने नया phone लिया है।
steps.model_visible_text: ठीक है। पर मेरा phone तो support करता है ना? मुझे doubt हो रहा है क्योंकि मैंने नया phone लिया है।

steps.purpose: Initiate line diagnostic to reassure the anxious user.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent offers to run a diagnostic to check the phone's status.
steps.text: मैं आपके number पर एक line diagnostic run करती हूँ ताकि हम phone check कर सकें। एक minute दीजिएगा।
steps.planner_rationale: The user is anxious about their new phone, so the agent runs a diagnostic to provide reassurance.

steps.purpose: Run line diagnostic.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent triggers the line diagnostic.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent calls the line diagnostic tool to verify the handset and SIM status.

steps.purpose: Return diagnostic result.
Provide diagnostic results confirming the phone is fine.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent states exact figures and statuses returned by the diagnostic tool.
steps.text: मैंने check कर लिया है। आपका handset बिल्कुल supported है और SIM भी registered है। Signal अभी -115 dBm है, जो कि उस fault की वजह से है।
steps.planner_rationale: The agent grounds the response on the diagnostic tool output to reassure the user that their handset is supported.

steps.purpose: Confirm understanding and seek reassurance.
steps.text: मतलब phone में कोई problem नहीं है ना? सिर्फ 6 hours wait करना है?
steps.clean_text: मतलब phone में कोई problem नहीं है ना? सिर्फ 6 hours wait करना है?
steps.model_visible_text: मतलब phone में कोई problem नहीं है ना? सिर्फ 6 hours weight करना है?

steps.purpose: Confirm the resolution and provide next steps.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent uses 'wait करना' and 'restart कर लीजिएगा' naturally.
steps.text: जी बिल्कुल। आपको बस 6 hours wait करना है जब तक fault ठीक नहीं हो जाता। उसके बाद phone restart कर लीजिएगा।
steps.planner_rationale: The agent confirms the user just needs to wait and naturally blends English and Hindi verbs.

steps.purpose: Ask if a callback is needed.
steps.text: अच्छा, समझ गई। एक और चीज़, क्या उसके बाद मुझे दोबारा call करना पड़ेगा?
steps.clean_text: अच्छा, समझ गई। एक और चीज़, क्या उसके बाद मुझे दोबारा call करना पड़ेगा?
steps.model_visible_text: अच्छा, समझ गई। एक और चीज़, क्या उसके बाद मुझे दोबारा call

steps.purpose: Clarify that no further call is needed.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent assures the user that the network will return automatically.
steps.text: नहीं, fault ठीक होने के बाद network अपने आप आ जाएगा, आपको दोबारा call करने की ज़रूरत नहीं पड़ेगी।
steps.planner_rationale: The agent answers the user's final question, interpreting the truncated turn correctly.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and end the call.
steps.text: ठीक है, बहुत बहुत शुक्रिया।
